Political economy and development

Political economy studies how political institutions and economic interests interact. Policies are not determined only by their technical economic effects because different groups can gain or lose from policy choices.

This perspective helps explain why economically beneficial reforms may be difficult to implement. Political incentives, distributional conflicts, institutions, and collective action can all influence policy decisions.
